note: He is the purest good-to-great case in the batch — "My body is not bad... but I want to just improve it and get better to it" — and emphatically not the deconditioned exclusion at 5'8" and 170 lb training six days a week. Income holds on disclosed numbers: about $2,500 clear a month and five-figure savings. Two criteria miss. He is a manager in a corporate office rather than a business owner, physician or equivalent, and said so plainly: "I don't have any, any other job besides this one job." And health is not the neglected area — it is the most attended part of his life, twelve hours a week in the gym plus testosterone therapy. What is actually neglected is sleep and structure. Useful signal for the ICP itself: the criteria have no way to describe someone doing everything except the right thing, which is exactly who this is.
